      From the manufacturer

      MOTOROLA G10 Power

      The phone comes with a 6.51-inch touchscreen HD display and features a 4 GB RAM along with a 64 GB internal memory. The phone is also decked with 48MP + 8MP + 2MP + 2MP rear camera and 8MP front camera for your images and videos. For power, the Phone relies on a 6000 mAh Li-Ion battery to give you that extra juice and power when you are on your phone. The phone features a beautiful and sleek design. The processing power of the phone is driven by the Snapdragon 460 Processor Processor that comes along with it.

      Processor and Battery

      The phone features Snapdragon 460 Processor Processor for the processing power you need. Enjoy better shuffling through applications and multitasking with this processor.

      The phone features a 6000 mAh Li-Ion battery for more juice and power in your phone. Enjoy more out of your phone with the battery that comes with the MOTOROLA G10 Power.

      Camera

      The phone comes with 48MP + 8MP + 2MP + 2MP rear camera and 8MP front camera for shooting images and videos seamlessly from your phone. Shoot pictures and create memories with the MOTOROLA G10 Power.

      Amazon Customer
      5 out of 5 stars
      Change Gesture Navigation to 3-Button Easily
      I am using this phone for last 4 years and I am super happy. Awesome display quality (even in daylight), very good battery backup, good sound quality and cool gesture control functionality makes it different from others. After 2 years my phone fell from my hand and broke the screen down right corner. I use the phone with that condition for another years without any issue. It's truly value for money. For those who are struggling with gesture control, you can change it to 3-button setup by going settings > Accessibility > System Navigation and select 3-button navigation from there. Please check the attached images for reference. Motorola is the best, go with it without any hesitation.
